notes: OEIS136269.A136269_conj: for k >= 1, (A136269 (3k) : R) = 3/4*10^(4k) + 5*10^(k-1) - 1, with A136269 n = floor(sum_{i<10^n} (i+1)^(1/3:R)). floor_sum_cube_even: floor of sum of cube roots of 1..M^3 is 3M^4/4 + M/2 - 1 for even M >= 2. Route: step (trapezoid excess (b-a)^3(a+b)/4 <= (1/a^2-1/b^2)/36), sum_bounds (telescoping), cube_bounds. Axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. Outside Lean: none (k = 0 excluded: formula gives 1/4; OEIS data agreement by certificate/check.py only).
